description: Binary plist whose URL and URLName are UTF-16BE (0x6n) strings, written by plutil
notes: Serialised by CoreFoundation via `plutil -convert binary1`, so the encoding is Apple's own even though the content is ours. A bplist string is 0x5n ASCII when every character fits in seven bits and 0x6n UTF-16 BIG-endian otherwise - note big-endian, where every Win32 format in this workspace is little-endian, so rclip_core::Utf16Le is the wrong tool. URL is https://xn--r8jz45g.example/ページ and URLName is 例え.
